title: Tree left rotation
summary: Recovered VA 0x423180 as a thiscall Tree member: promotes the right child, transfers its left subtree unless nil for parent updates, reconnects root or parent link, and attaches the pivot. Caller disassembly shows separate color maintenance.
test_description: 192 direct original-versus-C++ comparisons at identical fixture addresses: root, left child, right child and neither-child fallback; middle child flags 0, 1 and 255, including shared head sentinel; 16 color/payload patterns. Checks topology and complete fixture bytes including unrelated fields, sentinel links, payload and guards; installs FS and checks restoration after each original call.
known_limits: Valid linked storage is required; null and inaccessible pointers fault in the original and are not tested.
Node payload type and full tree object layout remain unknown; only accessed prefixes are modeled.
Tests cover this rotation only, not whole-tree insertion/deletion or balancing correctness.
Readable behavioral recovery; no byte-matching claim.
